claims.gist: Agentic AI is moving from pilots into customer service, IT and finance processes
Treat AI agents as a new identity class with their own access controls
AI governance will be built into procurement, security reviews and product development
Organizations are reorganizing data into managed data products with owners and schemas
Security budgets will shift toward incident response, backup integrity and containment
Energy and carbon pressures make workload energy profiles a design constraint

thesis: Five 2027 trends span agents, AI governance, data products, resilience and sustainable computing; fund those matching business priorities.
